CXLVII. von zwei Talenten Pfenninge derselben Münze. Nouerint presencium inspectores vel auditores vniuersi, quod ego Johannes rector ecclesie parrochialis in Rosenberg matura pre- habita deliberacione cum scitu et consilio nobilium dominorum Petri et Johannis de Rosenberg dominorum meorum graciosorum curiam in villa dicta Kwasow sitam, in qua Benessius dictus Haracher et Proczko successor suus olim residenciam tenuerunt corporalem, cum omnibus agris suis cultis et incultis rubetis pratis pascuis omnibus- que et singulis aliis juribus et prouentibus ad eandem spectantibus provt ego et ali i antecessores mei tenuere, honestis Paulo et Swa- choni villanis ac eorum heredibus jure emphiotetico possidendam et tenendam rite et legittime vendidi pro viginti duobus ta-[Ient-]is denariorum Wyennensium, quas quidem peccunias integraliter per- soluerunt hoc adiecto, quod di-[cti vill-]ani et heredes eorum michi omnibusque successoribus meis [futur-]is plebanis de eadem curia singulis a-[nnis] nomine census duo talenta denariorum Wyennen sium [in fe.stis] sanctorum videlicet Jeorgii et Galli diuisim censua- bunt. Item circa festum penthecostes quinquaginta oua sex pullos duos caseos quatuor denarios Wiennenses valentes duos falcatores et duos rastratores feni censuare tenebuntur et debebunt. Promiltens bona fide meo ac successorum meorum nomine dictam curiam cum suis appendiciis, vt premittitur, iuxta formam et ritum juris emphio- tetici in terra Boemie actenus obseruatos cum adiutorio dominorum meorum de Rosenberg predictorum disbrigare ac omnimode libertare sine dolo. In quorum omnium robur et euidenciam pleniorem sigillum meum proprium presentibus est appensum. Nos itaque Petrus et Jo bannes de Rosenberg antedicti recongnoscimus huiusmodi vendicio- nem de scitu et consilio nostris rite et legittime fore factam. In cuius euidens testimonium sigilla nostra ex certa sciencia presentibus 171 duximus appendenda. Sub anuo domini millesimo trecentesimo sep tuagesimo septimo quarta die mensis Marcii. entries.english:
On 4 March 1377, Johann, parish priest in Rosenberg, sells the farm in the village of Kwassow to the villagers Paul and Swacho under emphyteutic tenure for 22 talents of Viennese denarii, subject to an annual rent of two talents in the same coin. The farm had been occupied by Benessius called Haracher and his successor Proczko, and included all cultivated and uncultivated fields, thickets, meadows, pastures, and all other rights and revenues belonging to it, as Johann and his predecessors had held them. The villagers and their heirs are to pay the annual rent to Johann and his successors, the future parish priests, in two installments at the feasts of St George and St Gall. Around Pentecost they must also provide fifty eggs, six chickens, two cheeses, four Viennese denarii in value, two mowers, and two hay rakers. Johann promises, on behalf of himself and his successors, with the assistance of his lords Peter and Hans von Rosenberg, to defend and fully free the farm and its appurtenances according to the form and custom of emphyteutic law observed in the Kingdom of Bohemia, without deceit. Peter and Hans von Rosenberg acknowledge that the sale was duly made with their knowledge and counsel. Their seals and Johann’s own seal are attached.

Three seals hang from parchment strips; the first is damaged, fairly large, and in white wax, bearing St Nicholas and the inscription ‘S. Johanni … bani D…enbercb’; the second and third are Peter and Johann’s von Rosenberg seals in red wax, as in nos. CIV and CXIV.
